resources.string: MiDuo dunes — the launcher’s landscape, sized for your display.

Provides edge gestures for Back, Home and Recents across apps, plus notification and Quick Settings actions. Uses narrow touch overlays without reading screen content or observing other apps. Active when MiDuo is the default launcher and gesture navigation is enabled.

Swipe up from the bottom centre to go Home. Swipe up and hold for Recents. Swipe inward from either side to go Back. Hold the bottom centre without moving for two seconds to reopen this menu. These gestures replace basic navigation, not system animations.
Open system navigation settings to restore the three buttons.
